description: Deletes the specified Enumeration from the Project context. Scope: one project (requires a project ID). To act across all projects, use `deleteGlobalEnumeration` instead. Effect: irreversible — data removed or overwritten by this call cannot be recovered through the API. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

enumContext.description: The Enumeration context. (Allowed values are '~', 'plans', 'testing' and 'documents'. Use '~' for Work Item or general enumerations.)

projectId.description: The Polarion project ID (its URL segment, e.g. `myproject`), case-sensitive. Required to scope the request to one project. If the ID is unknown, ask the user; getProjects lists IDs only with global read access.

targetType.description: The configured subtype for this enumeration or custom field (e.g. `requirement` for a Work Item type). Use `~` (without quotes) when the configuration applies to every subtype.

name: deleteProjectEnumeration
